To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
g C3N3 nanosheets can serve as an excellent photocatalyst for water splitting, and can be applied to photocatalytic CO2 reduction and O2 evolution.
the photocatalytic activity of gC3N4 can be enhanced by using earth abundant co catalysts and/or nanosheets and by using gC3N 4 in oxygen evolution and CO 2 reduction.
the photocatalytic activity of gC3N4 can be significantly enhanced by loading noble metal-free co catalysts and exfoliating gC3N44 into nanosheets.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the synthesis of metal free co catalyst for enhancing the photocatalytic activity of g C 3 N4, the synthesis of two dimensional gC3N4 nanomaterials, the application of g C3 N4 based photocatalysts in photocatalytic water splitting, oxygen evolution and carbon dioxide reduction, and the application of gC3N 4 nanosheets as an electrode material for electrocatalytic water splitting.

the synthesis of novel photocatalysts for water splitting and CO2 reduction, the understanding of the mechanism of the photocatalytic reaction, and the design of new photocatalytic systems with high performance.
the development of efficient and cost effective photocatalysts for water splitting and CO2 reduction.

g C3N 4 based photocatalysts have been greatly improved in the last three years, and the research on g C3 N 4 has entered a new stage.
